resultConfig.failLabel: You did not meet the pass mark.
resultConfig.passDescription: Great work — you identified PX_843 among the seven edits, read the severity beside every code and established that no hard event would reject the claim at claim level, then did the part that matters most: you recognised that the limited liability record is not yours to update. You opened Request Claim Review from the Action menu, asked for a COB update, marked the review and wrote a comment saying what was needed, submitted the request to the E-COB team, and submitted the claim with no decision — because a claim being routed is not a claim being adjudicated. The 843 event resolves itself once COB updates the record.
resultConfig.failDescription: Pass mark is {passMark}%. Review the steps below to see where you can improve.
